hybrid_nli_lexical_fallback.architecture_note: Stage 1 evaluates semantic NLI for contradiction (P>=0.35) and strong entailment (P>=0.50). Stage 2 uses rule-based token overlap (>=30%) to disambiguate neutral NLI into PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED vs UNSUPPORTED. Does NOT use atomic decomposition on the 24 single-assertion benchmark items.
hybrid_nli_lexical_fallback.heuristic_qualification: Partial support assignment is an explicitly defined heuristic decision rule, not a formal semantic guarantee.
